## Checklist

- [ ] **Evidence recorded.** Summary and how to verify are filled in (commands, tests, or links). See [verify](principles/verify.md) and [playbooks/verify.md](playbooks/verify.md).

- [ ] **No secrets.** The pull request body and diff have no tokens, PATs, private config, or exploit details. Report security issues privately — [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

- [ ] **Public language safe.** No private credentials, internal roster names, or private links.
